> **Sitting and health**
> 
> Office workers in many countries now sit for more than nine hours a day. A large study following 8,000 adults found that those who sat longest had noticeably higher rates of heart disease, even when they exercised regularly in the evening. This surprised researchers, who had assumed that an hour at the gym would balance a long day at a desk.
> 
> The explanation appears to be that the body responds badly to long periods without movement, regardless of what happens later. Short, frequent breaks seem more effective than a single long workout. Standing up for two minutes every half hour produced better results in the study than a daily gym session. Employers, however, have been slow to change office design, partly because the benefits are difficult to measure.

**True / False / Not Given (6–8):**
6. Evening exercise fully protects people who sit all day.
7. The study followed 8,000 adults.
8. Most employers have redesigned their offices.

9. Office workers now sit for over ____________ hours a day.
10. Those who sat longest had higher rates of ____________.
11. Standing for ____________ minutes every half hour helped.

tu_cham.de:
Một người bạn viết thư nói họ luôn mệt mỏi và ngủ kém. Viết **70–80 từ** đưa 4 lời khuyên.
*Tiêu chí: should/shouldn’t đúng (2đ) · Why don’t you / You’d better dùng ít nhất 1 lần (2đ) · sau should là nguyên thể (1đ).*

1. Do you have a healthy lifestyle?
1. What advice would you give someone who wants to be healthier?
1. Is healthcare good in your country?

-----

-----

writing.de_tom_tat: Một người bạn nói họ luôn mệt và ngủ kém. Viết 70–80 từ đưa 4 lời khuyên.
writing.bai_mau: I'm sorry to hear you're not sleeping well. Why don't you try going to bed at the same time every night? You should also stop looking at your phone an hour before bed. You shouldn't drink coffee after lunch, because caffeine stays in your body for hours. How about taking a short walk after dinner? If none of this helps, you should see a doctor.

cham_diem.vi_sao: You should also stop · You shouldn't drink · you should see a doctor. Sau should luôn là động từ nguyên mẫu, không có to.
Why don't you try going… (sau Why don't you + V nguyên mẫu) · How about taking a walk (sau How about + V-ing). Hai cấu trúc gợi ý, dùng đúng dạng.
Giờ ngủ cố định · bỏ điện thoại trước ngủ · không cà phê chiều · đi bộ sau ăn.

dang_hoc: Ba cách khuyên, khác nhau về dạng động từ: should + V · Why don't you + V · How about + V-ing. Đây là chỗ dễ sai nhất.
Mở thư khuyên bằng câu đồng cảm: "I'm sorry to hear…" — lịch sự và tự nhiên.
Thêm lý do sau lời khuyên ("because caffeine stays…") làm bài thuyết phục hơn.
loi_thuong_gap: ❌ You should to see a doctor → ✅ You should see a doctor
❌ How about to take a walk → ✅ How about taking a walk
❌ Why don't you taking → ✅ Why don't you take

speaking.de_tom_tat: How do you stay healthy? / Do you sleep enough? / What advice would you give someone who is always tired?

cau_tra_loi.mau: I try to cycle twice a week and I watch what I eat. I'm not perfect — I drink too much coffee — but I've cut down on late-night snacks.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Thừa nhận một điểm chưa tốt làm câu trả lời thật hơn nhiều so với kể toàn điều tốt.

cau_tra_loi.mau: Honestly, no. I get about six hours, and I know I should get seven or eight. The problem is I study in the evening and my mind is still active.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: Dùng "I should" khi nói về điều mình biết là nên làm — đúng ngữ cảnh.

cau_tra_loi.hoi: What advice would you give someone who is always tired?
cau_tra_loi.mau: I'd suggest looking at their sleep routine first. They should go to bed at the same time every night and avoid screens beforehand. If that doesn't work, they ought to see a doctor.
cau_tra_loi.ghi_chu: "I'd suggest + V-ing" và "ought to" là hai cách khác để khuyên, tránh lặp "should" mãi.

cham_diem.vi_sao: should get · should go · ought to see — dùng đúng và đa dạng.
should /ʃʊd/ — chữ l câm. ought /ɔːt/ — gh câm.

meo_noi: should, would, could — chữ l đều CÂM: /ʃʊd/ /wʊd/ /kʊd/.
"I'd suggest" tự nhiên hơn "I suggest" trong hội thoại.
